authorization_scope: single DATA-only exploratory execution; execution authorization is not human scientific review
design_rationale: The earlier native screen used a donor tape generated without the registered external perturbation. V2 makes the matched-disturbance requirement explicit by using the actual perturbation-exposed closed-loop arm of each seed as the yoked sensor donor while applying the same external perturbation schedule to all three arms.

design.yoked_replay_contract: For every seed, yoked_replay consumes the complete sensor tape produced by that seed's actual closed_loop arm under the same external perturbation.
design.feedback_absent_contract: Observed position and velocity are fixed to zero while the body still receives the identical external perturbation schedule.

analysis_plan.direction_convention: positive control-minus-closed_loop difference means lower error in closed_loop
report: fraction of paired seeds with lower closed_loop error

integrity_requirements: same initial neural state within each seed
same initial body state within each seed
same graph fingerprint within each seed
yoked donor sensor digest equals the actual closed_loop sensor digest for that seed
feedback_absent observed sensor values are exactly zero
identical registered perturbation schedule for all arms
stopping_rule: Execute exactly the preregistered 20 seeds and three conditions. Retain failures; no replacement seeds and no outcome-dependent stopping.
claim_boundary: This is prospective exploratory synthetic DATA for the scoped H-EMB-001-B matched-disturbance comparison. It is not confirmatory EVID, not independent replication, not evidence of learned body schema, autonomy, consciousness, biological equivalence, real-device transfer, or 5D superiority. Human Review remains required.
